card.name: Inside capitalized drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through drug names written in ALL CAPS, such as DIPRIVAN, CYSTADROPS, MERCAPTOPURINE and EMTRICITABINE, at an inner piece before the rest of the name. Also fires inside the capitalized word TITRATION.

modes.label: DIPRIVAN
modes.description: The R inside the capitalized brand name DIPRIVAN in dosing and sedation text.
modes.example: require 2.5 mg/kg to 3.5 mg/kg of DIP<<R>>IVAN for induction when unpremed

modes.label: Other capitalized drug names
modes.description: An inner piece of other all-caps drug names such as CYSTADROPS, MERCAPTOPURINE or EMTRICITABINE.
modes.example: TREATMENT ACUTE EXACERBATION OF HEPATITIS B and RISK OF DRUG RESISTANCE WITH USE OF EM<<TR>>ICITABINE AND TENOFO

modes.label: UP-TITRATION
modes.description: The hyphen-T piece inside the capitalized word UP-TITRATION in carvedilol dosing headings.
modes.example: DOSAGE MUST BE INDIVIDUALIZED AND MONITORED DURING UP<<-T>>ITRATION.

card.writes: It seems to help predict the next letters of a long capitalized name, but the promoted tokens show no clear drug-related effect.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of drug names printed in capital letters, like DIPRIVAN.
